description: Two unrelated cooking notes (different seeds: different sentences) whose detector rows differ only in exclamation: a detector-clean pair that is not a minimal edit.

texts: He spends most weekends roasting vegetables at the cooking school. His neighbor says it is a pleasant way to pass the time. He owns two cookbooks and keeps buying more. He organizes meetups at the local center. He loves every minute of it. You should try it with him.

He spends most weekends baking bread at the market stall! He owns five cast iron pans and keeps buying more! He practices with a neighbor most evenings! His friends think it is rewarding! He loves every minute of it! You should try it with him!
